figures.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id), b AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(quantity*unit_cost_cents) stock FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date='2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id), z AS (SELECT p.product_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net,COALESCE(b.stock,0) stock FROM products p LEFT JOIN a ON a.product_id=p.product_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.product_id=p.product_id), q AS (SELECT *,100.0*net/NULLIF(SUM(net) OVER(),0) sales_share,100.0*stock/NULLIF(SUM(stock) OVER(),0) stock_share FROM z) SELECT product_id,net net_cents,stock stock_cents,ROUND(sales_share,4) sales_pct,ROUND(stock_share,4) stock_pct,ROUND(stock_share-sales_share,4) gap_points FROM q ORDER BY gap_points DESC

figures.title: 销售占比
figures.meaning: 衡量某个商品的年度净销售占全体商品净销售合计的比例，用来看销售贡献。

check.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id), b AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(quantity*unit_cost_cents) stock FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date='2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id), z AS (SELECT p.product_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net,COALESCE(b.stock,0) stock FROM products p LEFT JOIN a ON a.product_id=p.product_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.product_id=p.product_id), q AS (SELECT *,100.0*net/NULLIF(SUM(net) OVER(),0) sales_share,100.0*stock/NULLIF(SUM(stock) OVER(),0) stock_share FROM z)  SELECT SUM(net) FROM z

figures.interpretation: 销售占比 {result}：这个商品的年度净销售占全体商品净销售合计的比例。

notes.label: 总体
notes.text: 两项指标均以全体商品为比较总体

notes.label: 易错口径
notes.text: 销售额是期间流量，库存价值是时点存量；两个占比可比较相对结构，但不能代替库存周转率或利润率。
分母为 0 时，结果为空（NULL），不会报错，也不会写成 0。
